options_timer_desc:
A value that determines whether an event should run every few seconds.
Default is 20. (possible range is 5 sec ~ 2 mins)
options_gauge_color_desc: This will change the color of timer bar at the top of the screen.
options_dizziness_desc: This will reduce/removes an element that can cause dizziness.
options_family_friendly_desc: This will disable some bad words. (It's client-side option! You have to turn off all of them to prevent the bad words from coming out at all.)
options_dev_mode_desc:
This is Devloper Mode. If you found some bugs, you can turn this on and take a screenshot of the BepInEx console where the error occurred and send it to me.
My Discord is: lego_077, or you can send a mail to this: lego0_7@naver.com
